capabilities: Commit, pull and push changes on a schedule
Stage, unstage, diff and commit files from a source control view
Browse commit history and changed files
Resolve merge conflicts with highlighted versions in the editor
Initialize, clone, branch and manage remotes for repositories
extras: Mobile support is explicitly experimental and very unstable, using isomorphic-git with limits such as no SSH, no submodules and possible crashes on clone or pull; the README points to external full documentation for setup, authentication and troubleshooting, and notes that desktop needs shell and filesystem access to run the installed Git binary.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track note history, resolve merge conflicts, or back up and sync a vault through a Git repository.

relations.evidence: The Git plugin works on mobile thanks to isomorphic-git, a JavaScript-based re-implementation of Git
consider pairing this plugin with the Version History Diff plugin
One such alternative is GitSync, which is available on both Android and iOS

requires.name: Git remote service for authentication, push and pull

summary: Git integration that commits, pulls and pushes a vault on a schedule and adds source control, history, diff and conflict-resolution views inside Obsidian.
